definitions.explanation: A favorable time or situation for doing something.

examples.japanese: チャンスを{逃|のが}さないように。
examples.notes: チャンスを逃す = to miss a chance

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}で{働|はたら}くチャンスを{得|え}た。
examples.english: I got the opportunity to work overseas.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・チャンスを{つかむ|掴む} (to seize a chance)
・チャンスを{逃|のが}す (to miss a chance)
・チャンスを{与|あた}える (to give a chance)
・チャンスを{生|い}かす (to make the most of a chance)
・チャンスを{待|ま}つ (to wait for a chance)
・{絶好|ぜっこう}のチャンス (great opportunity)
・ラストチャンス (last chance)

RELATED WORDS:
・{機会|きかい} (opportunity - more formal)
・{好機|こうき} (favorable opportunity)
